name: Yotsukaidō (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Yotsukaidō city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised device of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Yotsukaidō, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 March 1955.

features.role: Yotsukaidō city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised device of curved strokes
